title: Lettuce Salad with Egg, Tomato, and/or Carrots, No Dressing

content.title: About
content.content: Lettuce salad is a light dish made of fresh lettuce leaves, boiled egg, sliced tomato and/or grated carrot. Other vegetables such as cucumber, pepper or radish can be added, but no dressing is used to preserve the natural flavors of the ingredients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Lettuce leaves are high in water content and help keep the body hydrated.
Egg provides a complete set of essential amino acids.
Tomatoes contain lycopene, a powerful antioxidant that becomes more bioavailable after cooking, yet remains beneficial when raw.
Carrots are one of the best sources of beta‑carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A.
The absence of dressing allows you to appreciate the true taste and texture of each component.

items.title: Rich in vitamins and minerals
items.content: The salad provides vitamin K (lettuce), vitamin C (tomato), vitamin A (carrot) and vitamin D and B12 (egg).

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: High water content and low fat make it suitable for weight‑controlled diets.

items.title: Supports eye health
items.content: Beta‑carotene from carrots and lutein from lettuce promote healthy vision.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Lycopene from tomatoes and vitamin E from egg yolk help combat free radicals.

items.title: Muscle and bone support
items.content: Protein from the egg and vitamin K from lettuce aid muscle function and bone strength.

items.title: Egg allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to egg whites.

items.title: Bacterial contamination
items.content: Raw eggs can carry Salmonella; use pasteurized eggs or fully hard‑boil them.

items.title: Pesticide residues
items.content: Non‑organic vegetables may contain pesticide residues; wash thoroughly before use.

items.title: Digestive discomfort
items.content: Large amounts of raw carrot may cause stomach upset in sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the salad cold. Rinse and dry the lettuce, dice the tomato, grate the carrot, hard‑boil the egg and slice it. Toss all ingredients together in a bowl and enjoy immediately, without any sauces.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared salad in an airtight container in the refrigerator for no more than 24 hours. Lettuce leaves wilt quickly, so it is best to assemble the dish just before serving.
